title: Tuesday 3 November
description: Anthropic publicly files for a Nasdaq IPO, after a confidential filing in June · Apple beats forecasts in CEO John Ternus's first earnings report · UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape on food exports · New York Times sues Brave browser over AI scraping and paywall bypass · Oil price falls over 6% to a two-week low on hopes of an Iran war breakthrough
